prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE production reference sheet for the Toktogi 2D game. Match the already displayed C011 springtail reference in rounded low-poly cartoon forms, clean dark blue-gray edge definition, restrained surface texture, readable four-tone shading, matte natural green/brown palette (the plant must retain its natural color, not springtail white). Off-white background, uniform neutral light, orthographic multi-view panels: top, front, left, right, back, underside/detail, consistently same object, no perspective distortion, no scenery, no shadow crossing panels, no text on object. Labels outside object in English with asset ID. Broad simple forms suitable for editable low-poly Blender geometry. Do not add a springtail character. This is a reference sheet, not a runtime sprite. Subject: B07 Phragmites australis: one tall upright jointed pale-green cane, alternating long narrow lanceolate leaves at nodes, and a fine branching tan conical feathery panicle on top. NOT a solid cattail cylinder. Show full plant and base with tiny rhizome hint. Selected whole height 2 m; no pot.
style_input_delivery: Reference displayed in conversation; new-image call omitted explicit image-path arguments.
correction: 시트의 가는 꽃차례 세부를 모두 복제하지 않는다. 원뿔 외곽과 분지 구조를 유지하고 작은 이삭을 저면수로 축약한다.
